description: Finds a street by name (or by neighborhood) in Brazil, up to 20 results: one for each street in each city. When the query has a house number that exists, the result has the point of that number.

cidade.description: Name or part of the name of the city.

q.description: Street name, 3 to 200 characters. A house number and a city in the query also count.

uf.description: Limits the search to one state (UF).

name: buscar
title: Find a street
